$comment: The storage proxy derives a tenant's S3 secret from one root key. Rust computes it to verify a signature; TypeScript computes it to hand the customer a connection. A divergence is a tenant who cannot authenticate at all — loud, but only if both sides read this file.

cases.why: The ordinary case: one service, first credential.
Rotation: same service, second credential. The id changes, so the secret does.
A different root key over the same identifier, which must not collide.
